title: Dead or Alive: Dimensions
subtitle: Four tournaments in a portable arena
summary: Dead or Alive: Dimensions is Team Ninja's Nintendo 3DS fighting game bringing together the characters and story of the series' first four main instalments. body: Dead or Alive: Dimensions is Team Ninja's Nintendo 3DS fighting game bringing together the characters and story of the series' first four main instalments. Its Chronicle mode revisits those tournaments through different fighters, while a roster of twenty-six includes previously unplayable bosses. The upper screen carries the action and the touchscreen provides access to move information. The compilation gives a new audience a route through an established cast. It also brings the series' close-range exchanges and hazardous arenas to a Nintendo system for the first time.

The series' relationship between strikes, throws and defensive holds gives an opponent's intention practical importance. A successful response depends on recognising what is coming and committing to the appropriate action. Training and the move display help make those options visible on a handheld, while the three-dimensional arenas provide opportunities to force a fighter into a dangerous position. The familiar cast gives returning players recognisable styles to investigate. For a newcomer, choosing one character becomes a way to learn a particular set of answers before approaching the wider roster.

Many stages return from Dead or Alive 3 and 4, while a new arena based on Metroid: Other M brings hazards associated with Team Ninja's work on that game. These surroundings matter because a useful attack can also change where the opponent lands. Arcade, Survival and training modes provide different ways to practise the same exchanges outside Chronicle. Dimensions makes its collection accessible through those repeated encounters: the history can be followed as a story, then revisited as a cast of fighters whose movements become more familiar through play.
